name: emw-relion-symmetrize_volume
help: Align a volume to the RELION convention for a point-group symmetry using relion_align_symmetry: it searches the orientation that best fits the symmetry, re-centres the map and rotates it onto the RELION symmetry axes. The symmetry itself is not applied. Input: a Volume. Output: the aligned Volume.

params.name: relion_align_symmetry.sym
params.label: Symmetry:
params.help: Target point group the volume is aligned to (--sym), e.g. C2, C3, D2, O, I1, I2, I3, I4. With C1 there are no symmetry axes, so the volume is only re-centred.
